title: Guitarist Jesse Jackson and the men in his band
summary: Vincent remembers Jesse Jackson as a guitarist with plenty of work and names Eddie Scott and others who played in his band.

blocks.x: Jesse Jackson. He has, huh? Jesse Jackson. Oh, he was a guitar player. You remember him? He used to have a little help in the mouth. He used to get better weight. He used to have two guitars. He said, well, we don't really play, but he would make motion. I think he would play, but he could make motion. I think he would play, but he couldn't make it, but he had all that work he used to get in there. Who'd he have in his band? Oh, Scott. He's a good bass player. You remember him? You remember Prince, Eddie Scott? Yeah. Oh, he's a good bass player.
Ask him who Jesse Jackson had in his band.
See, who Jesse Jackson had in his band? Well, he used to have different fellas, you know. Doug Ernest, Dave, all them fellas like that. And, uh, K-Tro, all them fellas in there from out front.
